_comment: Curated seed of high-priority US data brokers. Opt-out URLs/emails change often; verify before relying on them. category: people-search | marketing | risk | recruitment. difficulty: 1 easy web/email, 2 requires account/verification, 3 requires ID upload/notary/phone. jurisdiction is the broker's governing regime (US | GDPR | UK-GDPR); for US brokers the specific state-law template is chosen from the user's own residency, not this field. search_url (optional): GET URL template for the broker's public people-search with {first} {last} {city} {state} placeholders; values in the path get spaces turned into dashes, query values are URL-encoded. Absent/empty search_url means the broker is unsearchable and treated as assumed-exposed. scan (optional): config for the Playwright auto-scan pipeline -- {search_url (same template syntax as search_url above), result_selector (CSS selector for one result card), fields: {name, age, locations, relatives} (CSS selectors scoped within a result card)}. verified:false means the selectors are unconfirmed against a live page -- treat like opt-out URLs, needs a real scan to confirm before trusting. scan (optional): per-broker scan config -- search_url (as above), verified (false until selectors/URL confirmed against a live rendered page), optional result_selector + fields{name,age,locations,relatives} CSS selectors (omit selectors to use extract.py's generic fallback), notes. network (optional): shared-owner/database group id (peopleconnect | whitepages | beenverified | tps-family); a found/not_found verdict on one member is evidence for siblings -- see docs/exposure-scan-plan.md. scan.url_confirmed: date the search_url was verified against a live rendered page. scan.skip: true = do not auto-scan (wizard/JS-shell/bot-wall); keep for the manual link only.

scan.notes: Checked live 2026-07-09: EVERY entry URL (name-only, /Massachusetts, /Massachusetts/Boston) now lands on a 'Where does John live?' city/state wizard -- results are not URL-addressable. Manual link still useful (human fills the wizard). Needs form-mode; until then auto scan is skipped.

brokers.name: PeekYou

scan.notes: Checked live 2026-07-09: GET /search?name=... renders an empty JS shell ('found 0 people' with blank cards) -- results load client-side after interaction. Manual link works for humans. Needs form-mode; until then auto scan is skipped.

scan.notes: Verified live 2026-07-09: cards are div.success-wrapper-block with schema.org/Person microdata (itemprop name/address/relatedTo) -- clean and stable. Sponsored TruthFinder teasers live outside these blocks, so they're naturally excluded.

brokers.name: Addresses.com
brokers.notes: Intelius/PeopleConnect network. PeopleConnect network (shared database with Intelius/TruthFinder/Instant Checkmate/US Search/PeopleSmart/ZabaSearch/Addresses.com); one suppression covers the network.

scan.notes: Verified live 2026-07-09 against a real profile: 8 cards extracted, real person surfaced. Tailwind markup -- age nests inside the h2 (handled by extract._name_text), locations are /people/ anchors, relatives are /find/person/ anchors in the mt-2 block.
Live check 2026-07-09: connection refused (twice) from a residential IP -- site down or blocking. URL pattern previously confirmed via indexed pages. Re-test before enabling.

brokers.name: Dehashed
brokers.notes: Breach-data search engine. Breach-data search; requires an account, not scannable anonymously.

scan.notes: Re-checked live 2026-07-09: HTTP 403 from a residential IP (previously reachable). Skipped; manual link only. Re-test before enabling.

Domain did not resolve on 2026-07-09 (NXDOMAIN) -- scan config removed. These clone sites churn; the tps-family engine likely lives on under other domains.

scan.notes: URL pattern is correct (indexed pages), but live check 2026-07-09 hit a persistent Cloudflare interactive challenge that did not auto-clear even in a real browser. Expect unreachable; manual link (human solves challenge) is the only path. Auto scan skipped.

brokers.name: ZabaSearch

brokers.name: 411.com
brokers.notes: Whitepages network; opt out via Whitepages suppression. Whitepages network; shared data and suppression flow.

scan.notes: Re-checked live 2026-07-09 (real Chrome, this IP): page renders 'NaN people found' with no result cards -- the listing list is populated client-side after interaction, like Nuwber. Manual link works for a human. Skipped until form-mode. Whitepages-owned, so a Whitepages 'found' implies exposure via the network anyway.

brokers.name: AnyWho
brokers.notes: Intelius network.

scan.notes: Verified live 2026-07-09 against a real profile: the true person surfaced as a `found` match. No URL state scoping (nationwide, paginated) so page-1 not_found is weak. NOTE: page ships a Next.js JSON blob containing 'there are no matches' fallback copy -- extract() checks visible text only so it isn't a false not_found.
